headline: Data centers could erase decades of air quality gains
summary: AI data centers in Texas are set to significantly increase air pollution. Their massive electricity demand often relies on fossil fuels like gas. This trend threatens to undo decades of air quality progress.

headline: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
summary: Meta is issuing a new class of non-voting shares. Funds will primarily fuel the company's ambitious AI initiatives. These shares also cover acquisitions and employee compensation, trading from 2027.

headline: New York’s first microdrama film festival searches for its audience
summary: New York City held Alza, its inaugural microdrama film festival. The festival showcased vertical-format films, testing audience interest. Founded by a former Tribeca COO, it explored new cinematic experiences.

headline: Meta says it would’ve made over $22 billion if it didn’t have to pay a child safety settlement
summary: Meta's Q3 earnings were significantly impacted by a child safety settlement. The company paid nearly $10 billion towards the settlement. Without it, Meta's operational income would have exceeded $22 billion.

headline: Former BioWare Executive Producer Mark Darrah Says EA Might Be 'More Likely' to Sell IPs Like Mass Effect and Dragon Age After Studio’s Closure
summary: Former BioWare producer Mark Darrah commented on the studio's closure by EA. He suggests EA may now be more inclined to sell iconic IPs. Franchises like Mass Effect and Dragon Age could potentially be sold off.

headline: Star Wars: The Old Republic Fans Pay Their Respects to BioWare
summary: EA has officially shut down BioWare, prompting fan reactions. Fans of Star Wars: The Old Republic are paying tribute. The community is expressing respect for the beloved developer.

headline: The Daran 288Wh 600W LiFePO4 Power Station Drops to $125 After a 50% Off Amazon Coupon
summary: A Daran 288Wh 600W LiFePO4 Power Station is on sale. It's available for $125 after a 50% off Amazon coupon. The portable power station can keep electronics charged for days.

headline: David Fincher Cut 60 Pages From Quentin Tarantino’s Cliff Booth Script
summary: David Fincher directed "The Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth," a Tarantino sequel. Fincher made substantial cuts to Tarantino's original screenplay. Approximately 60 pages were removed from the script.

headline: Burnham defends Jackdaw decision as Badenoch urges PM to overturn ban on new oil and gas licences
summary: UK government defends the Jackdaw gas field, despite environmental opposition. The field is expected to begin gas production this month. Badenoch is urging the PM to overturn the ban on new oil and gas licenses.

headline: Websites taken down worldwide as critical cyber-security update issued
summary: Critical cyber-security vulnerabilities in PHP have been discovered. Described by AI as the most significant ever, they impact many websites. Websites globally were taken down to apply necessary security updates.

headline: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
summary: Kyiv was struck by missiles shortly after Russia agreed to resume peace talks. The agreement followed a call from the US for renewed negotiations. Despite peace talk hopes, conflict continues on the ground.

headline: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
summary: A US diplomatic push offers little hope for immediate peace in Ukraine. BBC's Russia Editor suggests President Putin feels no pressure to end the conflict. The current outlook for an imminent resolution remains bleak.
